# Lightdash MCP — agent access to this project

Lightdash serves an MCP endpoint on the instance itself at
`/api/v1/mcp` (list explores, find fields, run metric queries, render
charts). Registration needs an instance URL and a personal access
token — credentials, so nothing here writes a config file; export the
environment variables and register:

```bash
export LIGHTDASH_URL=...      # your instance, e.g. https://app.lightdash.cloud
export LIGHTDASH_API_KEY=...  # personal access token (ldpat_...)
claude mcp add --transport http lightdash-example-order-revenue-mart \
  "$LIGHTDASH_URL/api/v1/mcp" \
  --header "Authorization: ApiKey $LIGHTDASH_API_KEY"
```

Pin the server to one project with the `X-Lightdash-Project: <uuid>`
header. The CLI uses the same variables (`LIGHTDASH_URL`,
`LIGHTDASH_API_KEY`, `LIGHTDASH_PROJECT`) for non-interactive
`deploy`/`validate`.

`lightdash deploy` and the preview commands push this project to the
instance — that is data egress and needs explicit per-deploy
confirmation, the same rule as `wren genbi deploy`.
